subject: Runway triage: deal-to-pool tieout and Q4 reserved ask
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@stratus.ai>
Cc: contracts@stratus.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runway triage: deal-to-pool tieout and Q4 reserved ask

Hi all,

Following our pipeline review, Stratus (Jordan) is looking to lock a committed reserved pool for Q4 to guarantee throughput for their pilot + production ramp. High level asks from Jordan below; I want this thread to be the single place we tie the forecast to a concrete slot ask and finance run-rate.

Agenda:
- Confirm forecasted peak concurrent slots (see attached Q4_run_rate_model.xlsx)
- Map deal SLA/latency targets to pool sizing and fallback model variants
- Finance: delta vs on-demand run-rate, proposed monthly commit
- Infra: availability and lead time for additional tranche

Jordan: the workbook attached has our estimate based on their stated traffic patterns. If you can confirm expected P50/P95 queries/day and acceptable latency SLOs, we can finalize the slot ask.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben/Laura to validate sizing and return a slot_proposal by EOD Tue (attaching template).
2) Kim to surface infra availability and any tranche lead times.
3) Diego to prepare a one-page mutual action plan for contract + finance signoff.

Attachments: Q4_run_rate_model.xlsx (run-rate & slot calc)

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.example

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@stratus.ai>
Cc: contracts@stratus.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway triage: deal-to-pool tieout and Q4 reserved ask

Diego — thanks, looked through the workbook. Quick notes and clarifying Qs: 

- The model assumes 12M tokens/month P50, 28M tokens/month P95 for pilot+prod. Jordan, is that aligned with your expected throughput once the feature set is enabled?
- For slot sizing I recommend a conservative approach: request 40 reserved slots initially with a 4-week evaluation window. That buys us headroom for bursts but keeps monthly commit reasonable. See attached slot_proposal.csv with a per-week demand curve.
- Finance: we need to surface the committed discount tiers vs on-demand. I can draft a pricing delta but need the committed slot count confirmed.

Minor ask to Infra: if we request 40 slots today, what's the earliest we can guarantee allocation versus a 20-slot stepping?

I'll iterate the slot_proposal and send final by Tue EOD as requested.

Laura Bennett
VP, Growth & Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@stratus.ai>
Cc: contracts@stratus.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway triage: deal-to-pool tieout and Q4 reserved ask

Laura / Team — infra-side notes: 

- Current pool utilization across committed customers is 78%; with typical churn we can provision an additional 24 slots within 10 business days if we accept a staged handoff (20 -> +24). Full immediate +40 would require procuring a small tranche of on-demand GPUs for ~3 weeks while we re-balance, which adds ~9% cost this quarter.
- Alternative: aggressive quantization + batching per the attached quant_reduction_plan.pdf could reduce effective slot need by ~25% without changing models — tradeoff is slightly higher latency at P95.
- Risk: If Stratus requires strict P95 latency < 150ms for the largest prompts we should avoid quantized variants for the production traffic.

Recommendation: propose initial 30-slot commit with automatic step-up to 40 after 30 days if telemetry looks good. Finance can price the 30-slot baseline and include a staged ramp clause to minimize near-term infra churn.

Ben Carter
Director, Infrastructure Planning
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@stratus.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@stratus.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Runway triage: deal-to-pool tieout and Q4 reserved ask

Thanks — the traffic numbers are broadly correct: P50 ~11.5M tokens/mo, P95 ~26M tokens/mo (we'll forward precise telemetry by EOD). Our requirements:

- SLA: P95 latency target <= 200ms for chat flows, 150ms for short prompts if possible.
- Security: we need confirmation of data residency in us-west for the reserved pool.
- Contract: we can agree to a 30-slot baseline with an automatic step-up clause to 40 after 30 days contingent on usage; please confirm pricing delta and cancellation window. Deal id STR-3495.

Also can you send the draft mutual action plan + a statement of expected unit economics (monthly committed cost vs projected on-demand spend)? Contracts copied.

—Jordan Hayes
Head of Platform, Stratus AI
jordan.hayes@stratus.ai

Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Runway triage: deal-to-pool tieout and Q4 reserved ask — mutual action plan & action items

Team — quick summary and assigned owners so we can close this week: 

Decisions agreed (per Jordan):
- Baseline commit: 30 reserved slots for Q4 with a staged automatic step-up to 40 after 30 days contingent on usage.
- Region: us-west residency required for the reserved pool.

Action items: 
- Laura: finalize pricing delta and send a one-page pricing summary for 30-slot baseline + step-up clause by Thu 11/6 COB. (owner: laura_bennett)
- Ben: confirm provisioning lead time and, if necessary, timeline/cost for temporary on-demand tranche to cover the immediate ramp (due Wed 11/12). Also provide notes on P95 impact if quantization is used. (owner: ben_carter)
- Kim: confirm whether we can pin hardware to us-west and any KMS implications for residency. (owner: kimberly_park)
- Diego: produce Mutual Action Plan draft (mutual_action_plan.docx) and share with contracts for redlines by Fri 11/7. (owner: diego_fernandez)
- Jordan/Stratus: send telemetry export for exact P50/P95 by Tue 11/11 so we can validate billing model.

Risks & mitigations:
- If Stratus cannot accept quantized variants due to their P95 constraints, we will need to reserve the full 40 sooner. Mitigation: finance to include a 30->40 step-up with a short notice window to avoid infra churn.

I'll update the HubSpot deal (STR-3495) with the action items and timeline after Laura's pricing summary. Please reply only if there are changes to owners/timing.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
